description: FLUX 3 Image Klein (distilled, 5.6B) text to image, the baseline of the FLUX 3 templates. The prompt here is already a full caption - BFL's own upsampled caption for their man walking a dog example - because Klein was trained on long upsampler captions and turns short prompts into generic pictures; upsample-then-generate shows how to get one from a short request. Sixteen steps with no guidance: the distilled model is a flow map, so it takes no guidance scale and no negative prompt. Width and height must be multiples of 16, which the workflow declares; BFL states sides of 64 to 4096, which is not checked. Every component is placed on the GPU explicitly, about 19 GB of bf16 weights, which fits a 24 GB card at 1024x1024 with under 2 GB to spare. The weights are gated under the FLUX Kommunity License: accept it on the model page and log in with hf auth login first.

width.reason: FLUX 3 Image Klein's pipeline refuses a width not divisible by 16 (the VAE's 8x compression times the 2x2 latent packing), and only after the weights have loaded, so it is checked here first

height.reason: FLUX 3 Image Klein's pipeline refuses a height not divisible by 16 (the VAE's 8x compression times the 2x2 latent packing), and only after the weights have loaded, so it is checked here first
